content.short: Next Web3 Boilerplate is a Next.js Web3 template using Ethers.js, Web3-React, Typechain, and React Hooks.
content.description: The Next Web3 Boilerplate is an open-source dApp template created by Jeff Reiner. It provides a ready-to-use scaffold built with Next.js, Web3-React, Typechain, Ethers, and SWR, designed to help developers accelerate the early stages of a DApp project. With this template, developers can quickly deploy a minimal DApp and start building out their ideas using their preferred IDE and tooling. Contributions from developers are welcome to refine and extend the template.
